Changelog — Cue & Transport UI Overhaul

  1. Transient Detection toggle in Audio menu — Cmd+Shift+T, with checkmark state

  2. Cue Nudge Amount submenu in Audio menu — Presets: 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 ms. Default: 10ms

  3. Debug visuals decoupled — AnalysisTab has separate "Show Debug Visuals" toggle; transient markers show independently

  4. Dynamic triad color palette — Cue/transient colors adapt when cover art background is red or yellow (CueColorPalette.swift)

  5. Ghost cue marker — Previous cue position shown at 0.7 opacity, fades over 0.2s, cleared when zoom hides

  6. Cue press glow (C key) — Symmetric radial bloom (10/20/30px), stacks with rapid presses up to 1.5x, fades over 0.6s

  7. Cue directional trail (nudge/transient) — 20px gradient tail in the direction of travel, debounced (stays solid during rapid nudging), fades over 0.6s after last action

  8. Playhead directional trail — 14px subtle white gradient tail on seek/scrub, debounced, fades after 0.4s. Constant leftward shadow during playback restored

  9. Playhead direction-aware — Trail direction flips on seek backward

  10. Transient markers clear on toggle off — No stale markers when disabling analysis

  11. Scrub exits cue state — Clicking the transport resets cuePreview/pausedAtCue so next C press works correctly

  12. Cue shortcuts in Playback menu — C, X, comma, period, Shift+comma, Shift+period listed as reference

  13. zIndex layering — All markers/trails/playhead render above Metal waveform
